text: Level two, question four: two cows are each sold for nineteen thousand eight hundred rupees, one at a ten percent gain and the other at a ten percent loss; find the total loss in rupees. Question five: two articles each cost five hundred rupees; one is sold at a twenty percent profit and the other at a twenty percent loss; find the overall result. Question six: two articles are sold at nine hundred and ninety rupees each, one at a ten percent profit and one at a ten percent loss; find the net loss in rupees.
